description: This Java source file is a test class for verifying different strategies related to the 'Days In Year' calculation in loan products within the Apache Fineract project. It includes multiple test methods to validate validation errors, update strategies, and schedule calculations for different 'DaysInYear' strategies such as FEB_29_PERIOD_ONLY and FULL_LEAP_YEAR.

classes.name: DaysInYearCustomStrategyTest
classes.description: This is a test class extending BaseLoanIntegrationTest, focused on testing different 'Days In Year' strategies for loan products, including validation, updates, and schedule calculations.

methods.name: test_HttpError_for_ValidationError_DaysInYearsCustomStrategy
methods.description: Tests that creating a loan product with an invalid combination of daysInYearType and daysInYearCustomStrategy results in a 403 HTTP error.

methods.name: test_Update_DaysInYearsCustomStrategy_Value
methods.description: Tests updating the 'DaysInYearCustomStrategy' of an existing loan product and verifies the change.

methods.name: testFEB_29_PERIOD_ONLY
methods.description: Verifies the schedule calculation for a loan with 'FEB_29_PERIOD_ONLY' strategy starting on January 1, 2024.

methods.name: testFULL_LEAP_YEAR
methods.description: Verifies the schedule calculation for a loan with 'FULL_LEAP_YEAR' strategy starting on January 1, 2024.
